label: preparing
what: The innkeeper is arranging tomorrow's eighteen-hundred great-hall supper, with bread and lighting, and seeking the secretary's help reserving the hall and escorting me there. Although the supper itself has been disclosed, the request to describe the escort only as routine business suggests an undisclosed surprise purpose, possibly marking my forty years as mayor. The secretary knowingly assists with scheduling but explicitly declined to conceal the purpose; no evidence establishes other participants or proves the anniversary interpretation.
